# Originary | Portable verification for machine actions

> Originary helps companies issue and verify signed records of what agents, APIs, MCP tools, gateways, and payment flows did, without sharing logs or trusting a dashboard. Built on PEAC Protocol, an open standard for portable signed interaction records.

Last updated: 2026-05-13

Company: Poem, Inc.
Location: Delaware, USA
Contact: contact@originary.xyz

## What Originary does

- Issues signed records for boundary actions on APIs, MCP tools, gateways, provisioning flows, runtime lifecycle events, and machine-payment flows.
- Verifies records through Hosted Verify, exported bundles, or fully offline.
- Exports audit bundles for procurement, customer review, and incident reconstruction.

## What Originary does not do

Originary does not replace gateways, observability backends, payment rails, policy engines, identity providers, or agent runtimes. It records selected facts so another party can verify what happened later.

## Open standard

PEAC Protocol is Apache-2.0 and self-hostable. Verification does not depend on an Originary callback. See https://github.com/peacprotocol/peac.
